title: First and Last · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play First and Last · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner says a list of four common words once. The lead states the first and last words in the correct order. Both words and their positions are correct. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In First and Last, what counts as a successful turn?
options: Both words and their positions are correct.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: Both words and their positions are correct.
